mintAuthority.summary: JUSD's canonical native issuance is the non-proxy Polygon JUSD contract, whose owner EOA can call an uncapped mint function. Controls governing the non-canonical representation are assessed separately in bridgeRouteRisk and do not expand this native Mint Authority assessment. Polygon remains the best-supported canonical chain; issuer materials do not explicitly declare canonicality or rule out an untracked Ethereum deployment.

controls.evidence: At Polygon block 92140941 (2026-08-16 21:40:39 UTC), the verified non-proxy JUSD contract at 0x0ba8a6ce46d369d779299dedade864318097b703 returned owner() = 0x7be44b5d470d1cdea8703b6c5156267d4b22a42f; the owner address had no bytecode. A simulated mint(0x...01, 1) from the owner reached the mint path, while the same call from 0x...02 reverted with Ownable: caller is not the owner. The public mint function has no cap, collateral/deposit check, reserve reconciliation check, oracle condition, or supply ceiling. Ownership is transferable or renounceable, but the mint logic is not upgradeable.

review.evidence: Canonical-chain review at Polygon block 92140941 (2026-08-16 21:40:39 UTC): the verified non-proxy JUSD contract at 0x0ba8a6ce46d369d779299dedade864318097b703 is owned by the issuer-linked EOA 0x7be44b5d470d1cdea8703b6c5156267d4b22a42f, which can call the uncapped public mint function. No collateral, reserve reconciliation, oracle, or supply-ceiling condition bounds that native path, so economicCapSemantics remains unbounded and authorityPosture remains concentrated-admin. Controls governing the non-canonical representation are bridge machinery and are reviewed separately in bridgeRouteRisk; they are not counted as Polygon native Mint Authority. Reserve backing remains unverified, reconciliation remains unknown, and no prudential supervisor is evidenced. Polygon is the best-supported canonical chain, but issuer materials do not explicitly declare canonicality or rule out an untracked Ethereum deployment.
